description: Tile, grout and thinset calculator — Tile job takeoff from length_ft and width_ft (or area_sqft): tiles to buy with pattern waste (pattern=straight|offset|diagonal|herringbone|chevron, or waste_pct), boxes (optional sqft_per_box or pieces_per_box), grout pounds and 10/25 lb bags from joint width and tile thickness (sanded vs unsanded), thinset 50 lb bags and trowel notch by tile size (large-format notes), cement backer board sheets, screws and mesh tape. Optional tile_w_in, tile_l_in (default 12x12), joint_in (default 0.125), tile_thick_in (default 0.375), surface=floor|wall. Offline estimate. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
